LanKit — third-party license notice
===================================

This folder contains a C# port of Goldberg Emulator "lobby_connect" discovery
logic (find peer rich-presence "connect" / lobby id on the emulator LAN) for
SmartGoldbergEmu. It loads the installed Detanup/gbe_fork steam_api64.dll at
runtime; it does not redistribute that binary.

Upstream concepts / tool:
  https://github.com/Detanup01/gbe_fork
  tools/lobby_connect/lobby_connect.cpp
  (originally Mr. Goldberg's Goldberg Emulator)
